description: Star Relay grows from six levels to twelve across two packs and gains a shared daily board, with the same budgets and the same calm turn-based play.
lead: The relay room doubles in size. Twelve hand-priced levels ship in two packs beside a daily board that deals every player the same grid, while the script, style and page weight budgets all stay green.
merge_note: Pre-merge: this entry ships in the same change per the standing rule; the merge identifier is recorded after the gate passes on the exact head.

reasoning.DEV: Development branched from the merged line after the remote and login checks passed. It extended the level table to twelve rows, added the UTC date-seeded daily board as a side mode with no new storage keys, grouped the picker, and moved the progress cap to the table length. The full relay contract, the generation gate and the rebuild run green before review, with the script budget proved under twenty kilobytes.

stages.rationale: Verified the remote and login, then branched from the merged line.
Added the second pack, the daily board, the grouped picker and the twelve-level copy in the same branch.
Rebuilt the site, ran the relay contract and the generation gate green, and proved the weight budgets.

title: Star Relay grows a second pack with a daily board
